fullContentHtml:
Indian Overseas Bank LBO Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) has released the admit card for the post of Local Bank Officer (LBO). This recruitment was released for 250 posts. Applications for the Indian Overseas Bank LBO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 08 August 2026, to 24 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 24 & 29 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their Indian Overseas Bank LBO Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
